status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: The sharing-mask proposal remains retired as a review-introduced regression. Source grounding retains a separate lost-notification failure path: after bounded read retries are exhausted, the replacement handler can return without updating its timestamp baseline or invoking the callback, and closing the conflicting handle alone does not guarantee another notification. The experimental retry-only correction is not ready for a safe author proposal: callback exception and lifetime behavior, synchronized retry supersession and timestamp updates still require a coherent contract and focused proof. Existing thread patterns did not resolve those coupled concerns. No new build, test or author-facing proposal is claimed.

next_action: Resume the saved review stage in the next dashboard update.
